description:
Forward discounted-cash-flow valuation (two-stage Gordon-growth model): caller provides growth + WACC + terminal assumptions, returns per-share intrinsic value (`value_per_share_cents`, cents of `result.reporting_currency` — USD for US filers, the filer's own currency otherwise; never converted) + 5×5 sensitivity grid. In prose quote `result.metrics_display` verbatim (`value_per_share` is the per-share value in currency units, e.g. "$249.17"; each grid cell carries `value_per_share_display`), never the cents. Pulls FCF base + net debt + shares from R2; caller can override any field. Definitions (consistent with `get_financial_ratios` / `get_capital_allocation_profile`): FCF base = operating_cash_flow − capex (absolute USD); net_debt = total_debt − (cash + short-term investments), long-term marketable securities not netted; `result.net_debt_basis` says whether it was reported or an assumption (debt_assumed_zero keeps known cash when debt is undisclosed). Shares resolve via a fallback chain (valuation row → fact CommonSharesOutstanding → net_income/eps_diluted), reported as `result.shares_source`. The pulled inputs are echoed in `result.inputs_echo` with their source lineage so the valuation is reproducible and traceable. `result.inputs_provenance` cites the source `fact_id` of every input pulled from the filings, and the FCF base (when it is operating_cash_flow − capex from cited facts) carries a `derived_id`: cite those for the inputs. The valuation outputs rest on your assumptions, so no filing backs the ASSUMPTIONS, but the arithmetic is checkable: when every input was pulled from cited facts (fcf_source "trend", no fcf_base_override or shares_override), `result.outputs_provenance.value_per_share.derived_id` is the id of the value per share, and each `result.sensitivity_table` cell carries its own `derived_id`; the id states your assumptions (WACC, growth, terminal growth, years), so cite the id beside the figure you quote and the fact-check recomputes it exactly. An overridden input, a three_statement run or a degenerate model ships with no id: quote those as your own assumptions, never as a verified figure. A null `value_per_share_cents` means the model is degenerate (e.g. WACC ≤ terminal growth, or FCF base ≤ 0) or a required input was unavailable — it is NOT a zero valuation; the `reason` field explains. Use the returned figures exactly. Use this when you want to drive the assumptions yourself; for the pipeline's pre-computed DCF/DDM value and inputs (no assumptions needed) use `get_valuation_metrics` instead. Does NOT persist a report — use `create_report` (report_type:'reverse_dcf') for that. 

`fcf_source` (default "trend"): "trend" compounds a single FCF base by `stage1_growth_rate` every year (the original behavior, unchanged). "three_statement" instead runs a full linked Income Statement / Balance Sheet / Cash Flow projection (`project_three_statement`'s engine) and feeds its year-by-year FCF stream into the same PV math — `stage1_growth_rate` is then ignored (kept for echo only) because revenue growth + margins drive FCF instead of a flat compounding rate. The projection detail (including per-year `tie_out_ok`) is returned in `three_statement_detail` when used. Tier: sp500+.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD) for the auto-pulled inputs. Fundamentals are filtered by SEC accepted_at (strict PIT). Omit to use the latest knowable inputs.

fcf_base_override.description: Override the auto-pulled FCF base (USD). Leave unset to use R2-derived.

fcf_source.description: "trend" (default): compound fcf_base by stage1_growth_rate every year (unchanged original behavior). "three_statement": derive the FCF stream from a full linked 3-statement projection instead — see the tool description for details.

shares_override.description: Override shares outstanding. Leave unset to use R2-derived.

stage1_years.description: Number of explicit high-growth projection years before the terminal stage (3–15). Defaults to 5.

three_statement_assumptions.description: Only used when fcf_source is "three_statement". Overrides for the underlying projection; unset fields use project_three_statement's defaults.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company to value, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B.

name: compute_dcf

_meta.description: Provenance envelope — data lineage for every MCP response

cost_usd.description: Per-call cost transparency. Omitted for subscription-only and free tools, which have no MPP price.

basis.description: mpp_charge = real pay-per-call charge (a card or MPP payment through agent-pay). mpp_rate_card = indicative price, not billed.

billed.description: true = this amount was actually charged via MPP for this call. false = indicative MPP-equivalent value only: no charge was made for this call (it was within your plan).

data_plan.description: Access plan: sample | sp500 | pro | full

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the FINANCIAL STATEMENTS were last rebuilt in bulk. Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp when the snapshot was exported

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds this tool call took, measured server-side around the handler.

limit_warnings.description: Soft-warning array for partial fulfillment. Each entry carries a stable subcode + remediation.options[]. AI agents pattern-match on subcode.

mpp_offer.description: Present when figures still need payment: the MPP option (price, resource_url, request body) for the full run.

mpp_override.description: Set when this single response was paid for over MPP (card, agent-pay): the payment's order was honoured for this call only. agent-pay captures the payment only when this is present.

mpp_verification.description: Verification tools only, when some figures are outside the caller's plan. Figures the plan covers are always verified free; a Valuein account also verifies its first figures free, once, figures outside its plan included (the verification trial, size in pricing://current). served_free = own-plan figures plus trial figures; trial_used / trial_remaining = this run's draw and what the account has left; needs_payment = figures still to pay for (the paid verification run). A guest has no trial: note says how to get it.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

reset_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the window resets

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy

title: Compute Forward DCF
